title: The Talos Principle
provenance: Reported by barredespace (highball-db#1189, 2026-11-13), Apple M6, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 26 minutes: in fullscreen it wouldn't show on their external display, in a window it did. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Croteam's 2014 puzzle game. Reported playable on an Apple M6 with DXMT on the default engine (r28) over 26 minutes. In fullscreen it stayed off the player's external display, while in a window it showed there. Steam lists a Mac version as well.

knownIssues.symptom: In fullscreen the game doesn't show on an external display, in a window it does (Apple M6, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1189)
knownIssues.cause: a fullscreen game opens on the Mac's main display. Not measured with this game, the same thing happened to Elden Ring (highball#667)
knownIssues.fix: make the external display the main display in System Settings, Displays, then start the game, which fixed it for Elden Ring (highball#667). Or play windowed or borderless with the Display setting on the game's page set to that display
